quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the high frequency of NBA injuries
quotes.excerpt: Maybe it seems a little bit more frequent, but I obviously I don't know the numbers.
quotes.quote: Maybe it seems a little bit more frequent, but I obviously I don't know the numbers, but I just feel like it's a lot right now. And is the schedule asking too much of the players? No, I mean the schedule is the schedule. It's been that way for I don't know how many years, decades. But obviously, unfortunate things happen, but yeah, I don't think it's the scheduling part. I think maybe it's like the style of play. We're playing a fast-paced basketball.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson emphasizes the importance of daily recovery
quotes.excerpt: It's kind of important to do your recovery every single day as or as much as you can.
quotes.quote: The recovery part is tough because there's so many days when you feel good. You're like, oh, I feel good, I don't got to maybe not do anything today. And then you wake up tomorrow and all of a sudden you're sore. It's kind of important to do your recovery every single day as or as much as you can to kind of stay in the right shape possible. But I mean, one thing I would change about it is just nothing, honestly. We have so much access to a lot, so I wouldn't really change a lot.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the necessity of being ready for the season
quotes.excerpt: No matter what happens, no matter what happens, whether you go far in the playoffs, it's our job.
quotes.quote: It was the shortest summer, but not really. I think it's important to understand that no matter what happens, no matter what happens, whether you go far in the playoffs or short summer or whatever, it's our job to be ready. It's really on us to be ready. In the past, there used to be longer training camps, more preseason games, but everything's being shortened now to like, basically you need to be ready by the time you walk in the training camp. And so, regardless of what you have to do, the onus is on the individual. That's what I see.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's early season performance
quotes.excerpt: In the NBA, sometimes you win those, sometimes you don't. So I don't think there's much stock.
quotes.quote: They're probably just like a few minutes stretch here or there. I mean, what we lost to Philly twice, both are a one or two possession game. We lost to Boston, which was a one or two possession game. I mean, we weren't our best version of ourselves, and in the NBA, sometimes you win those, sometimes you don't. So I don't think there's much stock in those, one, because they were such close games. And like I said, this is the first, not even 10 games into the season, so last year I always like talk like, and I don't want and there's no disrespect to this team or whatever, but last year, Chicago started off the season like five and 0 or whatever, and Kendrick Perkins like, oh, they're contenders in this that and the other, and then, you know, I think they they end up being like a playing team. So it's like, like when I was in Portland, we were 10 and three, number one in the West, through 13 games, and then, you know, I got traded and we weren't, I think we might have had like 25 wins in February. So, you know, the first 10-15 games, it's, you know, I don't think you put too much stock in this as long as you're continuing to compete and continuing to grow and get better.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's need for consistent 48-minute play
quotes.excerpt: We haven't put a full 48-minute game together. I played a good first half or played a good second half.
quotes.quote: I would say just be like you said, we have like stretches where like we don't we haven't put a full 48-minute game together. I played a good first half or played a good second half, but I haven't played one full good game together. And so, we're doing the right things, but we have lapses and then like and now we're now we're playing catch up or we don't start the game well, now we have to play catch up. Like it's just like we haven't put a full 48 good game together. I honestly I do like the way we're competing. I do like the way we're doing things on the court. We just need to do it more consistently throughout the game and not have lapses and we will. We've done it in the past. This is the new journey. This is this is new, this is this is in last year, this is completely new. We can we can look back on our experience last year and say, oh, this is how we grew as a team because we we weren't we didn't start off great last year either. So there's always an adjustment period.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's growth and decision-making
quotes.excerpt: I think it's you're able to grow as a team, you're able to see like where you are.
quotes.quote: There's pros and cons to it. I think it's you're able to grow as a team, you're able to see like where you are. Imagine like if we were playing doing all this stuff, right, but then finding how to finding ways to win in the end of the game. Yeah, great, yeah, we'll be we'll have probably a better record, but we'll be masking some of our problems as a team. Like we we get to see what's wrong, obviously with the losses, and then we get to try and get back and get better with them. And so, do I want to lose? No, but we're we're learning and we're getting better and so this is a long year.
